# AgentFreeze

> AgentFreeze records a local, no-exec integrity baseline for supported agent-extension state that
> may exist outside a dependency manager.

Canonical repository: https://github.com/skikkh/agentfreeze
License: MIT
Lockfile: agentfreeze.lock
Current format: version 1

## Commands

- `agentfreeze scan`: read-only inventory
- `agentfreeze freeze`: write the current baseline
- `agentfreeze verify`: compare the current state with the baseline
- `agentfreeze watch`: poll the baseline and emit changed observations

## Security boundary

AgentFreeze verifies observed content integrity and drift. It does not assert that an extension is
safe, execute extensions, or monitor runtime behavior. MCP environment/header values, likely
secret fields, and URL credentials/query values are redacted before hashing; unknown secret shapes
may remain and lockfiles require review before publication. Internal symlinks are hashed without
traversal; symlinked extension roots and unreadable sources fail closed.

## Existing standard relationship

Seal (https://sealfile.dev/) defines project-local bundle authorization. Microsoft APM
(https://github.com/microsoft/apm) defines project and global package state, dependency
installation, lockfiles, audit, and policy. Snyk Agent Scan
(https://github.com/snyk/agent-scan) provides security scanning and centralized background
monitoring. AgentFreeze v0.1 tests a narrower offline, no-exec baseline for supported local state
outside those declared manager boundaries. It does not claim compatibility or uniqueness.
